Horizons Arabic Level 1

Arabic letters and first words, brought to life through listening, pictures and writing.

Install for Windows

Optional: adds an icon that opens the workbook in your browser. Windows 10/11, 64-bit.

What’s included

Explore 28 Arabic letters through 560 words, 560 example sentences and 56 short stories. Listen to the Arabic audio, connect words with pictures, practise letter shapes and revisit lessons at your own pace. Designed for guided learning at home or in the classroom; no child account is required.

Languages and compatibility

After activation, each learner sets a private password and signs in with their own email on any device. All updates, additions and fixes for Level 1 are included.
